script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

Title: The Green Thumbs

INT. BEN'S KITCHEN - MORNING

BEN (40s), a passionate but struggling horticulturist, is cutting fresh flowers from his garden. He's wearing old jeans and a t-shirt, with a pair of glasses perched on his nose. He hums to himself as he works, lost in the beauty of his garden.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Ben's life revolved around two things: the land and his family. But the latter was fading away...

EXT. BEN'S HOUSE - DAY

Ben's wife, LUCY (30s), a lawyer, pulls up in her car. She walks to the kitchen door, a determined look on her face.

LUCY
(shouting)
Ben! The kids and I are leaving for a week's vacation. Don't forget to water the plants!

BEN
(smiling)
I won't, dear. I promise.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Ben, alone, watches a gardening show on TV. His eyes fill with longing as he watches the presenter's lush, vibrant garden.

BEN
(whispering to himself)
I can create something like that. I'll show Lucy and the kids what I'm capable of.

INT. COMMUNITY GARDEN - DAY

Ben arrives at the community garden, where he sets up a small plot. He begins planting seeds, working tirelessly despite the sun's heat.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Determined to regain his family's respect and love, Ben threw himself into his garden, pouring his heart and soul into every seed he planted.

INT. BEN'S HOUSE - NIGHT

Ben sits at the kitchen table, sketching out plans for his garden. He's completely engrossed in his work.

INT. COMMUNITY GARDEN - DAY

Weeks pass, and Ben's plot starts to bloom. His neighbors take notice and offer their help and advice. Ben gladly accepts.

INT. LUCY'S OFFICE - DAY

Lucy receives an invitation to a local gardening competition. She looks at it thoughtfully.

LUCY
(on the phone)
Ben, there's a local gardening competition coming up. It could be a great opportunity for some exposure. Do you want to enter?

INT. BEN'S HOUSE - NIGHT

Ben is skeptical, but decides to give it a try. He works day and night, perfecting his garden.

INT. COMMUNITY GARDEN - DAY

The day of the competition arrives. Ben's garden is a sight to behold. His neighbors come to support him.

INT. GARDENING COMPETITION - AFTERNOON

Ben nervously waits for the judges' decision. The crowd around him murmurs in anticipation.

JUDGE (50s)
Ladies and gentlemen, the winner of the competition is... Ben!

The crowd erupts in cheers as Ben's family rushes to him. They hug him, tears in their eyes.

LUCY
(tearfully)
I'm so proud of you, Ben.

BEN
(smiling)
It's all thanks to you and the kids. I couldn't have done it without you.

INT. BEN'S HOUSE - EVENING

Ben sits in his living room, surrounded by his family. They're all laughing and enjoying each other's company.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Ben's dream had come true. He'd shown his family that his ambition could bring them closer together. And in the process, he'd created a garden that would bloom for generations.

The End.
